question: QL on Ozempic pens?
assumption: NY Medicaid (inferred because this is a coverage/claim question and no program was named).
answer: Assuming NY Medicaid: **Ozempic® pen is preferred** on the NYRx PDL and the row has **no F/Q/D/QL flag**. So the retrieved PDL does **not specify a quantity limit for Ozempic pens** as of today (10/18/2026). The GLP-1 class does have **CC**: confirm an FDA-approved/compendia-supported and Medicaid-covered indication; **PA is required if a GLP-1 and DPP-IV are used concurrently**. Note: **Ozempic® tablets are non-preferred**; I treated your question as the pen product only. NYRx policy says preferred drugs can still be subject to F/Q/D edits, but no Ozempic pen QL was listed in the retrieved evidence.
